Both ends re-read from the company's own earnings-call transcripts in this run and confirmed as the company-wide total on the same definition (products plus projects and services), not a segment. Trigger is the Q4 FY26 call transcript filed 26-May-2026 (Rs 1,044.31 cr vs Rs 612.40 cr, +70.5%). The valuation case rests on a primary-document fact: cash and equivalents of Rs 977.9 cr as on 30-Jun-2026, 57.4% of the Rs 1,704.83 cr market capitalisation, so enterprise value is Rs 726.93 cr against trailing revenue of Rs 798.86 cr (0.91x) and trailing PAT of Rs 101.67 cr (7.15x). Stated against it on the card: profit is still falling (Q1 FY27 PAT Rs 22.95 cr against Rs 39.59 cr), the order book is disclosed ONLY in call transcripts, management explicitly refuses conversion guidance, the book includes AMC and contracts 'up to 5 years' so it is not an EPC backlog, and BSE median turnover is Rs 7.7 lakh a day with NSE turnover not measured in this run.

The order is real and was read in full: a letter of award from Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd for 14,000 off-grid DC solar photovoltaic water pumping systems of 5 HP for the whole state under the Magel Tyala Saur Krushi Pump Yojana, total value Rs 330.29 cr INCLUDING GST, to be executed within 60 days of the work order or notice to proceed. It fails both halves of the measured order test in runbook 144c. SIZE AGAINST SALES: Rs 330.29 cr is 19.0% of a trailing year's revenue of Rs 1,742.46 cr (Q1 FY27 Rs 505.19 cr + FY26 Rs 1,532.54 cr - Q1 FY26 Rs 295.27 cr), i.e. in the under-25% bucket that reached 2x within two years 21.4% of the time, not the 25-50% bucket that reached it 35.7% of the time. RARITY: this is the opposite of a first-in-two-years filer - the 240-day BSE announcement window alone holds six order or empanelment announcements (23-Oct, 21-Sep, 26-Aug, 06-Jul and two earlier empanelment letters), and the serial-bidder bucket with eight or more prior filings reached 2x only 17.3% of the time and 5x never. Worse, this repo's own order-wins check of 11-Oct-2026 established WHY: GK Energy's confirmed wins crossed 0.745x its stated order book within 183 days, yet the next stated book FELL from Rs 863.98 cr (30-Sep-2025) to Rs 803.24 cr (31-Dec-2025), because 60-day pump execution churns the book instead of compounding it. The last book the company stated is Rs 541 cr as on 30-Jun-2026 (Q1 FY27 presentation, filed 07-Aug-2026) - lower again. So a Rs 330 cr order on a Rs 541 cr book is routine throughput, not a step change. Noted for the watch list rather than the page: the stock is down 59.5% in a year, closed at Rs 94.05 against a 52-week low of Rs 90.15, trades at a BSE header PE of 8.52, and grew Q1 FY27 revenue 71% and PAT 62% year on year. If a book-to-sales step change ever shows up in a stated figure, it becomes an order-book-lane candidate; today it does not.

PAGE-RENDERING DEFECT FOUND AND REPORTED, NOT FIXED (it needs a change to docs/ideas.html, which this run's prompt puts out of scope - 'do not touch any file outside docs/ideas/'). docs/ideas.html's md() renders markdown ONE SOURCE LINE AT A TIME, and its inl() applies /\*\*(.+?)\*\*/ where '.' does not match a newline. So any **bold** span that wraps across two source lines is never converted and the literal asterisks show on the page - and, separately, every hard-wrapped paragraph renders as several

elements instead of one. Measured this run by extracting md(), inl() and table() from docs/ideas.html (lines 397-455) and running them over every field of every card in Node: 742 fields render, 805 tables render correctly, and 21 fields carry literal '**' on the live page. The affected fields, in card order: BHAGYANGR.update[2026-10-12], FONEBOX.update[2026-10-09], SHANTIGOLD.update[2026-10-13], VIVIANA.update[2026-10-10], ORIANA.update[2026-10-12], CEIGALL.update[2026-10-12], CEIGALL.update[2026-10-13], RAJESH.thesis, RAJESH.social, VRAJ.thesis, MOREPENLAB.thesis, AEROENTER.social, TINNARUBR.model, TINNARUBR.red_flags, TINNARUBR.valuepickr, PPEL.thesis, PPEL.red_flags, PPEL.valuepickr, FAIRCHEMOR.thesis, FAIRCHEMOR.model, FAIRCHEMOR.red_flags. None of them is a wrong number - it is purely how the text displays. Two possible fixes, for the owner: (a) in md(), join consecutive non-blank, non-table, non-list, non-heading lines into one logical line before calling inl() - this also fixes the split-paragraph problem for every card ever written; or (b) add the 's' flag to the bold and italic replacements in inl(). (a) is the better one. Today's two cards were written hard-wrapped, were caught by this check, and were re-flowed to one line per paragraph before publishing, so they render clean - verified by re-running the same md() harness: 25 tables, 0 problems. The 21 older fields were left exactly as their own runs wrote them, because the user's rule is that a card and its updates are a dated record and are never rewritten.
